name: Discord MCP Server
description: A comprehensive Model Context Protocol server that enables interaction with Discord for channel management, message searching, and automated communication. It features enterprise-grade security with multi-tenant authentication, rate limiting, and real-time monitoring via a built-in inspector dashboard.
